| Item | Value |

## 1. Requirement Summary

No user stories or acceptance criteria were supplied. The user gave `https://demoqa.com/books` and named no flows. Scope is the **Book Store Application only**, assumed from the URL (`intake.md`). Requirements REQ-01 to REQ-13 were derived from discovery (`requirements.md`).

| REQ | Flow | Priority | Scenarios |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| REQ-01 | Book list (8 books, columns, pager disabled; service failure) | Medium | 3 |
| REQ-02 | Search on /books | Medium | 12 |
| REQ-03 | Sort (Title, Author, Image not sortable) | Low | 3 |
| REQ-04 | Book detail (guest and signed in, Back To Book Store, unknown ISBN) | Medium | 4 |
| REQ-05 | Login (valid, wrong password, unknown user, empty, partial) | High | 5 |
| REQ-06 | Session and logout | High | 3 |
| REQ-07 | Guest restrictions | High | 3 |
| REQ-08 | Add to collection, duplicate add | High | 2 |
| REQ-09 | Profile collection, delete, persistence, empty state | High | 4 |
| REQ-10 | Registration validation only (no account is created) | Medium | 3 |
| REQ-11 | Navigation (menu, New User) | Low | 2 |
| REQ-12 | Responsive 375x812 | Medium | 2 |
| REQ-13 | Cross-browser (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit) | Medium | Execution model, no own scenario |
| ASSUMPTION-02 / -03 | Log out from the list; Go To Book Store target | n/a | 2 (TC-33, TC-46) |

User decisions that shape the suite:

- **Scope:** Book Store Application only (assumed from the URL; the other demoqa sections are out of scope).
- **I1 / registration:** existing login accounts only. Registration was not selected; no accounts are created by the tests.
- **I2 (answer to Q1):** one existing account per browser: `existingUser` for Chromium, `firefoxUser` for Firefox, `webkitUser` for WebKit. Masked credential check OK for all three; the three user names were verified to be different without printing them. Collection tests therefore run on all three browsers.
- **I3:** accessibility out of scope, confirmed by the user ("no need").
- **Scenario approval:** given **in advance** by the user before the list existed (the user was unavailable). Recorded with `workbook.mjs approve` for 48 scenarios, and re-recorded after the TC-19 step correction and the TC-27/033/046 strengthening under the user's "run and fix" authorisation (2026-11-10T20:18:20Z), and again on 2026-11-11 after the user asked to promote the discrepancies to defects ("do it"), which changed 9 scenarios.
- **Test runs:** authorised in advance ("Yes, run and fix"). Accepted side effects: books added to and removed from each browser's account collection (left empty), one wrong-password login per account per run. No accounts created, nothing else deleted.
- **Defect policy:** a test behind an open defect fails (plain Failed) until the site is fixed. Defects are tracked in the workbook only and are not reported externally.

## 2. Application URL and Environment

- URL: `https://demoqa.com/books` (HTTP 200, no redirects; base URL `https://demoqa.com/`).
- Environment: public ToolsQA practice site, shared with everyone, not owned by us. Page title is `demosite` on every page; no `data-testid` attributes.
- Third-party ad and tracking hosts are blocked by an auto fixture; reCAPTCHA is deliberately not blocked.
- Tooling: Playwright 1.64; projects chromium, firefox, webkit; `screenshot: 'on'`; `trace: 'off'` in the three files that use accounts.
- Node: the machine's default Node 20.11.1 is blocked by Microsoft Defender; all commands used Node 26.13.0 via fnm.
- Credentials: git-ignored local file `credentials/credentials.xlsx`, roles `existingUser`, `firefoxUser`, `webkitUser` (fields `userName`, `password`); masked check OK on 2026-11-10.
